generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The new `SystemDataStreamMigrationInfo` and related classes require thorough testing to handle all edge cases, including failures during reindexing.
The code assumes the existence of `DataStream.isSystem()` and `IndexMetadataBuilder.system(boolean)`. If these methods don't exist, it will cause compilation errors.
The new `includeSystem` parameter in predicates and actions needs thorough testing to ensure correct behavior in all scenarios.

review_comment: Why is this no longer needed?

At 1198 of this file `feature.getIndexDescriptors()` has changed to `feature.getSystemResourceDescriptors()` which includes both indices and data streams. The rest of the removed code was essentially the same as there, so now remaining code covers both indices and data streams.
